display.usage: Public campaign headings, festive typography, hero sections, and main titles.
display.rationale: Evokes an elegant, traditional Indian/Bengali festivity and adds warmth and heritage.

body.usage: Data grids, admin dashboards, forms, buttons, and dense financial tables.
body.rationale: Highly legible workhorse sans-serif for clear data readability, numbers, and dense information.

deep_brown.description: Base dark background for the public campaign. Represents the deep earthy tones.

ivory.description: Base light background for admin dashboards and public cards. Represents purity and canvas.

vermilion.description: Sindoor red. Used for primary CTAs on public pages, and danger/failed states in admin.

warm_gold.description: Accent color for festive flair, secondary buttons, and pending states.

public_campaign.card_bg: bg-[#2A1B18] or bg-[#FFFFF0] for contrast cards

public_campaign.spacing: Generous padding (p-8 to p-16) to allow decorative elements to breathe.
public_campaign.layout: Asymmetrical, narrative-driven flow. Use max-w-7xl containers. Hero section should feature central festive typography with elegant ivory cards overlapping.
public_campaign.cards: Ivory cards on deep brown background. Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl with 1px warm gold borders (border-[#D4AF37]/30) and soft glowing shadows.

admin_dashboard.spacing: Dense, compact spacing (p-4 to p-6) for maximum data visibility.
admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (Deep Brown bg, Ivory text) with main content area (Ivory bg, Dark text). CSS Grid for metric summary cards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4).
admin_dashboard.cards: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-lg). Flat, 1px subtle borders (border-[#2A1B18]/10) without heavy drop shadows to keep the UI clean and analytical.

visual_enhancers.motifs: Incorporate subtle Alpona (white floor-art patterns) as background opacity masks (opacity-5) in the public campaign. Use Lotus and Diya shapes as section dividers or bullet points.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use double-line borders or ornate corner accents for the Receipt Verification page to make it feel like a premium printed document.
visual_enhancers.motion: Subtle, elegant fade-ins (framer-motion). Ensure all motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion` for accessibility.

buttons.public: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: Vermilion bg. Secondary: Transparent with Warm Gold border.

components.status_badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), px-2.5 py-0.5, text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider. Follow status_semantics colors.
components.tables: Admin only. Dense rows, sticky headers. Hover states on rows (hover:bg-[#F5F0E6]). Use left-alignment for text, right-alignment for INR currency columns.
components.forms: Floating labels or clear stacked labels. High contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4AF37]).

component_path.shadcn_ui: Use standard Shadcn components in `/app/src/components/ui/` for the Admin Dashboard (Tables, Dialogs, Select, Tabs, Data-tables). Strip extreme rounded corners to match the elegant, trustworthy feel.
component_path.custom_marketing: Build custom HTML/Tailwind components for the Public Campaign hero, subscription pricing cards, and immersive calendar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope'.
Install lucide-react for standard icons, and react-icons for any specific festive/traditional icons if needed. DO NOT use emojis.
Apply dual-theme logic: Public pages should default to the Dark/Ornate theme (Deep Brown base). Admin routes (`/admin/*`) should default to the Light/Clean theme (Ivory base).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="subscribe-btn"`, `data-testid="admin-login-submit"`).
For the ₹3,500 breakup card (₹2,500/₹300/₹700), use an elegant Bento-style layout or an ivory card with warm gold dividers.
For the Receipt Verification page, design it to look like a physical, verified certificate with Alpona border motifs.
Ensure total WCAG compliance: High contrast ratios (especially text on Vermilion or Gold), semantic HTML, and visible keyboard focus states.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or floating headers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.

public_hero_durga_idol.description: Beautiful and detailed Durga idol adorned with vibrant decorations.

public_festive_diya.description: Close-up of traditional Diwali oil lamps with glowing flames, representing warm gold and festivity.

public_lotus_accent.description: Pink lotus flower in bloom for traditional touch.

public_alpona_garland_texture.description: Close-up of colorful indian festival garlands with lotus charms, useful for subtle background overlays.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over vermilion or gold meets APCA or WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text). Use ivory text on deep brown, and deep brown text on ivory.
accessibility.motion: Wrap framer-motion animations with useReducedMotion hooks to disable animations for users preferring reduced motion.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactive elements, crucial for the mobile-first subscription flow.
